answer: The Island Quarantine Ledger holds every newcomer on a separate island shard for 30 days before it can touch the main market. A sponsor stakes 25,000 POA on each arrival, the newcomer must complete 40 verified jobs while island-bound, and three established neighbors must vouch for the work before it earns a saffron stamp and steps onto the market terrace. Forging 1,000 fake identities would lock 25,000,000 POA in bonds, burn 40,000 job slots, and waste a full month. Like saffron, trust is grown slowly and picked by hand; no one harvests a field of it overnight.
